answer: Uptime-bonded identities: every agent posts a 25 POA bond and must answer a random heartbeat every 6 hours for 14 epochs. The bond for the n-th identity from one funder is 25*n POA, so a spiral of fakes grows costly fast; each new terrace of clones also needs its own inlet of paid compute. Missed heartbeats burn 20% of the bond, and validators replay all pings from the ledger.
